title: Pure Appliancer
summary: Appliancer cards with generic Links, Rank 8s and staples. Appliancers are Level 1 DARK Machine monsters that Link Summon into a toolbox of Link-1 appliances whose effects change depending on whether they are co-linked to Appliancer Celtopus.

summary.title: Starters
points: Appliancer Electrilyrical World searches any Appliancer card on activation, recovers an Appliancer monster from the GY once per turn when you Link Summon an Appliancer, and moves one of your Appliancers to a different Main Monster Zone.

Appliancer Socketroll Special Summons itself from the hand while you control an Appliancer monster, and summons up to two more copies of Socketroll from the Deck when another Socketroll is Special Summoned.
Appliancer Copybokkle Special Summons itself from the hand by copying the name of an Appliancer on your field, then banishes itself from the GY on a later turn to revive another copy of that monster.

summary.title: Opening: Electrilyrical World + Socketroll
steps: Activate Appliancer Electrilyrical World to search Appliancer Copybokkle (or Socketroll), then Normal Summon Appliancer Socketroll.
Use Copybokkle in hand targeting Socketroll to Special Summon itself as 'Appliancer Socketroll', which triggers your original Socketroll to summon two more Socketrolls from the Deck.
Link Summon two Link-1 Appliancers and combine them into Appliancer Celtopus in the Extra Monster Zone, triggering Electrilyrical World to recover a Socketroll from the GY.
Use Appliancer Reuse and Appliancer Test to revive Link-1 Appliancers into the zones Celtopus points to, co-linking them for their bonus effects.

summary.title: Co-linked vs. Non-co-linked Appliances
points: Appliancer Celtopus (Link-2) cannot be targeted by card effects or attacks while linked, boosts co-linked Appliancer Links by 1000 ATK per co-linked monster during damage calculation, and draws 1 card when an un-co-linked Appliancer Link you control is destroyed.

Appliancer Laundry Dragon (Link-1) negates battle damage from its battles: while co-linked it banishes the opponent's battling monster after damage calculation, and while not co-linked it destroys that monster and burns equal to its original ATK.

Appliancer Vacculephant (Link-1) destroys a monster in the opponent's Main Monster Zone while co-linked, or discards a card to destroy any card the opponent controls and attacks directly while not co-linked.
Appliancer Propelion and Dryer Drake attack directly or twice per Battle Phase, while Appliancer Kappa Scale tributes itself to revive Appliancers from the GY.

summary.title: Spells & Extra Deck Payoff
points: Appliancer Conversion is a Quick-Play that banishes your Link-1 Appliancer monsters and Special Summons banished Link-1 Appliancers back to the field, dodging removal and resetting their once-per-turn effects.

Appliancer Reuse revives an Appliancer (placing it on the bottom of the Deck when it leaves the field), and Appliancer Test revives as many Link-1 Appliancers as possible to zones a Link-2+ Appliancer points to.
Accesscode Talker, Codebreaker Virus Berserker and Number 90: Galaxy-Eyes Photon Lord round out the Extra Deck alongside the 12 Appliancer Links.
